# memtwig — Complete Technical Reference (v1.4.1)

memtwig is an open-source (Apache 2.0), git-native, multi-org Markdown memory layer for AI coding agents and assistants, distributed as a single static Go binary (`CGO_ENABLED=0`, ~14 MB, Linux/macOS/Windows) with an embedded dark local Studio Web UI (`memtwig ui`, featuring Notes reader/editor, Knowledge Graph, Proposals diff reviewer, Audit log, and self-service Settings for providers, vaults, and harnesses) and interactive TUI (`memtwig tui`).

## Install
```bash
curl -fsSL https://memtwig.com/install.sh | sh
# Ensure ~/.local/bin is in PATH:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
memtwig version   # memtwig 1.4.1
```
Or with Go:
```bash
go install github.com/memtwig/memtwig/cmd/memtwig@latest
```

## Quickstart (One-Command Setup)
```bash
# Fastest start (creates or imports ~/notes, indexes it, detects installed AI harnesses):
memtwig setup            # add --install to connect detected harnesses automatically

# Or set up explicit multi-org vaults in one command each:
memtwig init ~/notes/personal --name personal --kind personal \
  --always-include "persona/**"

memtwig init ~/notes/acme --name acme --kind org \
  --match-path "$HOME/work/acme-payments/**" \
  --match-remote "github.com/acme-corp/*"

memtwig init ~/notes/nordic --name nordic --kind org \
  --match-path "$HOME/work/nordic-store/**" \
  --match-remote "github.com/nordic-retail/*"

# 3. Inspect vaults, index, and diagnose
memtwig vault list
memtwig index --full
memtwig doctor

# 4. Search (strictly scoped by cwd + git remote; supports prefix matching, e.g. "Postgres" -> "PostgreSQL")
cd ~/work/acme-payments && memtwig search "Postgres"
cd ~/work/acme-payments && memtwig search "Shopify"   # -> no matches (active vaults: acme, personal)

# 5. Governance & deterministic proposals
memtwig proposal add infra/postgres.md --vault acme --kind append \
  --reason "Add pg_stat_statements alert" \
  --content "- [2026-11-23 · dev] Alert if p95 > 250ms."
memtwig proposal list --vault acme
memtwig proposal show <id> --vault acme
memtwig proposal ok <id> --vault acme
memtwig proposal no <id> "outdated" --vault acme

# 6. Lint all vaults, curate, open local Studio Web UI or TUI
memtwig check --all
memtwig curate             # add --llm for semantic contradiction check
memtwig ui                 # embedded local Web UI at http://127.0.0.1:8787
memtwig tui                # interactive terminal UI

# 7. Connect AI harnesses
memtwig install claude --dry-run
memtwig install cursor --dry-run
memtwig install codex --dry-run
memtwig mcp                # stdio MCP server
memtwig serve --addr 127.0.0.1:8787   # Streamable HTTP MCP + REST API + RBAC + Studio UI
```

## Complete `config.toml` Schema (`~/.config/memtwig/config.toml`)
```toml
version = 1

[identity]
soul_file = "~/.config/memtwig/SOUL.md"   # optional identity file injected by `hook --event session-start`
inject_on_session_start = true

[retrieval]
default_top_k = 5
max_snippet_chars = 400
rrf_k = 60

[embeddings]
# provider: "none" | "ollama" | "openrouter" | "deepinfra" | "openai" | "cloudflare"
provider = "none"
model = "bge-m3"          # e.g. "baai/bge-m3" (openrouter), "BAAI/bge-m3" (deepinfra), "bge-m3" (ollama)
endpoint = "http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/embeddings"
api_key_env = ""          # e.g. "OPENROUTER_API_KEY", "DEEPINFRA_API_KEY", "OPENAI_API_KEY"
account_id = ""           # Cloudflare Workers AI account ID
dimensions = 1024         # default 1024; changing model/dimensions auto-invalidates SQLite index_meta
timeout_ms = 3000
cosine_threshold = 0.45

[llm]
# Used by `memtwig curate --llm` for semantic contradiction checks
# provider: "none" | "openai" | "ollama" | "openrouter" | "groq"
provider = "none"
model = ""                # e.g. "llama-3.3-70b-versatile" (groq), "openai/gpt-4o-mini" (openrouter)
endpoint = ""
api_key_env = ""          # e.g. "GROQ_API_KEY", "OPENROUTER_API_KEY", "OPENAI_API_KEY"
timeout_ms = 15000

[vaults.personal]
path = "~/notes/personal"
kind = "personal"                 # "personal" | "org"
default_write = "direct"          # "direct" | "propose" | "readonly"
always_include = ["persona/**"]   # globs inside personal vault always visible in org scopes
max_note_bytes = 8192

[vaults.acme]
path = "~/notes/acme"
kind = "org"
default_write = "propose"
match_paths = ["~/work/acme-payments/**"]
match_git_remotes = ["github.com/acme-corp/*"]
max_note_bytes = 8192

[server]
addr = "127.0.0.1:8787"
audit_log_path = "~/.cache/memtwig/audit.jsonl"

# Optional RBAC tokens for team HTTP mode (if omitted, local-only admin mode is active):
# [[server.tokens]]
# name = "acme-ci"
# token_env = "MEMTWIG_ACME_TOKEN"
# role = "proposer"               # "reader" | "proposer" | "writer" | "admin"
# vaults = ["acme"]
# path_globs = ["infra/**"]
```

## Note Format & Governance
Notes use YAML frontmatter or lightweight top-of-file headers:
```markdown
---
status: active
valid_from: 2026-11-23
updated: 2026-11-23
owner: vittorio
---
# Style Preferences

- Keep replies concise.
```
- **Soft cap**: 8 KB per live note (`max_note_bytes`). Outdated facts are moved to append-only `<dir>/archive/<file>` files (e.g. `infra/archive/postgres.md`) via `memtwig invalidate <path> --match "..." --reason "..."`.
- **Owner lock**: Notes with `owner:` (or `proprietario:`) block direct agent writes even inside `direct` vaults; edits are routed to `.curator/proposals.json`.
- **Decisions**: `memtwig decide "..." --note <path>` logs to `decisions/YYYY-MM.md`; in `org` vaults (`default_write = "propose"`) or owner-locked notes, the update to `--note` is queued as a review proposal.
- **Deterministic proposals**: SHA1 IDs + append-only `.curator/history.jsonl` ensure rejected proposals never reopen.
- **Secret scanner**: `memtwig check --all` detects leaked API keys/tokens/private keys and blocks `memtwig sync`.

## MCP & HTTP API Reference
- **Stdio MCP (`memtwig mcp`)**: exposes `memory_search`, `memory_get`, `memory_status`, `memory_propose`, `memory_write`, `memory_proposals_list`.
- **HTTP Server (`memtwig serve` / `memtwig ui`)**:
  - `GET /health`
  - `POST /mcp` (Streamable HTTP MCP with Bearer RBAC)
  - `GET /api/v1/status`, `GET /api/v1/notes`, `GET /api/v1/note?vault=...&path=...`, `GET /api/v1/search?q=...`
  - `GET /api/v1/proposals` (includes unified `diff`), `POST /api/v1/proposals`, `POST /api/v1/proposals/<vault>/<id>/<approve|reject>`
  - `POST /api/v1/reindex`, `POST /api/v1/curate`, `GET /api/v1/audit?n=50`
  - `GET /` serves the embedded local Studio Web UI.
